lines.t: Another day beneath the noise
Another pool of passing things
Chasing what will leave me empty
Promises that take their toll
But in the quiet of the evening
When I open up your world
The spark of truth begins to kindle
Like a fire stirring in my soul
A whole little flame rising up within me
Passion burning in my soul
Word of God begins to kindle
Fire cannot be controlled
A small little flame rising up within me
Standing firm against the night
Truth awakens something holy
Calling me to burn bright
All day long the flesh keeps pulling Chasing what the world displays
Passing things that promise pleasure Fading with the passing days
When I open up your word And truth begins to rise
All the luster of this world
Slowly fades before my eyes
Oh, little flame rising up within me
Passion burning in my soul
The word of God begins to kindle
A fire that cannot be controlled
Oh, a little flame rising up within me Standing firm against the night
Truth awakens something holy Calling me to burn
That little flame begins to rise Fed by every word of truth
Every page becomes a lantern Lighting paths of deeper proof
All the noise begins to quiet All the shadows start to part
And the fire born from scripture Burns alive within my heart
Let this fire rise within me Let it shine for all to see
Set apart among the many Burning bright in purity
Standing firm while others wander Holding fast to what is true
You forgot a life within me Setting the whole field ablaze
Oh, little flame rising up within me Passion burning in my soul
The word of God begins to kindle A fire that cannot be controlled
Oh, little flame rising up within me Standing firm against the night
Truth awakens something holy Calling me to burn bright
Oh, little flame rising up within me
